name: aishikshamitra-motion
description: AIShikshaMitra — Your AI Teaching Assistant: promo motion graphic built with Remotion

scripts.render: remotion render AIShikshaMitra out/raw.mp4 --crf=20 --x264-preset=slow && npm run master
scripts.master: remotion ffmpeg -y -i out/raw.mp4 -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-16:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 -ar 48000 -c:a aac -b:a 192k -movflags +faststart out/AIShikshaMitra.mp4
